mapper.sql: id, report_name, index_key, report_period, data, creation_date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO baseline (report_name, index_key, report_period, data, creation_date) VALUES (#{reportName}, #{indexKey}, #{reportPeriod}, #{data}, #{creationDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE baseline SET report_name = #{reportName}, index_key = #{indexKey}, report_period = #{reportPeriod}, data = #{data}, creation_date = #{creationDate} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, report_name, index_key, report_period, data, creation_date FROM baseline WHERE report_period = #{record.reportPeriod} AND report_name = #{record.reportName} AND index_key = #{record.indexKey}
